cert.card-foot.en: Hawkeye is independent and nonpartisan. This certificate is not INEC accreditation.
cert.card-foot.ha: Hawkeye mai zaman kanta ce kuma ba ta goyon bayan kowace jam’iyya. Wannan takardar shaida ba izinin INEC ba ce.
cert.card-foot.ig: Hawkeye nweere onwe ya, ọ naghịkwa akwado pati ọ bụla. Asambodo a abụghị ikike sitere n’aka INEC.
cert.card-foot.yo: Hawkeye jẹ́ olómìnira, kò sì ṣe ti ẹgbẹ́ kankan. Ìwé-ẹ̀rí yìí kì í ṣe ìwé àṣẹ láti ọ̀dọ̀ INEC.

cert.card-line.en: Completed a practice run and the observer quiz
cert.card-line.ha: Ya kammala gwajin atisaye da tambayoyin mai lura
cert.card-line.ig: Mechara ọsọ omume na ajụjụ onye na-ekiri ihe
cert.card-line.yo: Ti parí eré àdánwò àti ìdánwò olùwòran

cert.check-at.ha: Kowa na iya duba ta a:
cert.check-at.ig: Onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịlele ya na:

cert.done-body.en: You completed a practice run and the observer quiz. Thank you for learning to observe well.
cert.done-body.ha: Ka kammala gwajin atisaye da tambayoyin mai lura. Mun gode da ka koyi yadda ake lura da kyau.
cert.done-body.ig: I mechaala ọsọ omume na ajụjụ onye na-ekiri ihe. Daalụ maka ịmụta otu esi ekiri ihe nke ọma.
cert.done-body.yo: O ti parí eré àdánwò àti ìdánwò olùwòran. A dúpẹ́ pé o kọ́ bí a ṣe ń wòran dáadáa.

cert.issue-failed.en: Could not issue your certificate. Check your connection and try again.
cert.issue-failed.ha: Ba a iya fitar da takardar shaidarka ba. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka ka sake gwadawa.
cert.issue-failed.ig: Enweghị ike inye asambodo gị. Lelee njikọ gị ma nwaa ọzọ.
cert.issue-failed.yo: A kò lè ṣe ìwé-ẹ̀rí rẹ. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìsopọ̀ rẹ kí o sì tún gbìyànjú.

cert.lede.en: Complete a practice run, then answer 7 short questions on observing well and within the law. Get them all right and you receive a certificate to print or share.
cert.lede.ha: Kammala gwajin atisaye, sannan ka amsa gajerun tambayoyi 7 kan yadda ake lura da kyau kuma bisa doka. Idan ka amsa duka daidai, za ka sami takardar shaida da za ka iya bugawa ko rabawa.
cert.lede.ig: Mechaa ọsọ omume, wee zaa ajụjụ nkenke 7 gbasara otu esi ekiri ihe nke ọma n’ụzọ iwu kwadoro. Ọ bụrụ na i zaa ha niile nke ọma, ị ga-enweta asambodo ị nwere ike ibipụta ma ọ bụ kesaa.
cert.lede.yo: Parí eré àdánwò kan, lẹ́yìn náà dáhùn ìbéèrè kúkúrú 7 nípa bí a ṣe ń wòran dáadáa ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú òfin. Tí o bá gba gbogbo wọn tọ́, wàá gba ìwé-ẹ̀rí tí o lè tẹ̀ jáde tàbí pín.

cert.load-error.en: Could not load your certificate. Check your connection and try again.
cert.load-error.ha: Ba a iya loda takardar shaidarka ba. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka ka sake gwadawa.
cert.load-error.ig: Enweghị ike ịdọnye asambodo gị. Lelee njikọ gị ma nwaa ọzọ.
cert.load-error.yo: A kò lè ṣí ìwé-ẹ̀rí rẹ. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìsopọ̀ rẹ kí o sì tún gbìyànjú.

cert.name-label.ha: Sunan da za a buga (na zaɓi)

cert.name-note.en: Your name stays on this device. It is never sent to Hawkeye.
cert.name-note.ha: Sunanka yana nan a wannan na’urar kawai. Ba a taɓa aika shi zuwa Hawkeye ba.
cert.name-note.ig: Aha gị na-anọ naanị na ngwaọrụ a. A naghị ezigara Hawkeye ya.
cert.name-note.yo: Orúkọ rẹ wà lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí nìkan. A kì í fi ránṣẹ́ sí Hawkeye.

cert.practice-first-body.en: The certificate needs one practice run on this account. It takes about 5 minutes, and nothing you enter counts as a real result.
cert.practice-first-body.ha: Takardar shaidar tana buƙatar gwajin atisaye ɗaya a wannan asusu. Yana ɗaukar kusan minti 5, kuma babu abin da ka shigar da zai zama sakamako na gaske.
cert.practice-first-body.ig: Asambodo ahụ chọrọ otu ọsọ omume na akaụntụ a. Ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 5, ọ dịghịkwa ihe ị tinyere ga-agụ dị ka ezigbo nsonaazụ.
cert.practice-first-body.yo: Ìwé-ẹ̀rí náà nílò eré àdánwò kan lórí àkàǹtì yìí. Ó gba nǹkan bí ìṣẹ́jú 5, kò sì sí ohun tí o bá tẹ̀ sí i tí yóò kà gẹ́gẹ́ bí àbájáde gidi.

cert.practice-recheck.en: I have done it — check again
cert.practice-recheck.yo: Mo ti ṣe é — tún ṣàyẹ̀wò

cert.q1.en: When do you photograph the result sheet (EC8A)?
cert.q1.ha: Yaushe za ka ɗauki hoton takardar sakamako (EC8A)?
cert.q1.ig: Olee mgbe ị ga-ese foto mpempe akwụkwọ nsonaazụ (EC8A)?
cert.q1.yo: Nígbà wo ni o máa ya fọ́tò ìwé àbájáde (EC8A)?

cert.q1-a.en: As soon as you arrive at the polling unit
cert.q1-a.ha: Da zarar ka isa rukunin zaɓe
cert.q1-a.ig: Ozugbo i ruru ngalaba ntuli aka
cert.q1-a.yo: Ní kété tí o bá dé ẹ̀ka ìdìbò

cert.q1-b.en: When the result is announced and posted after the count
cert.q1-b.ha: Idan an sanar da sakamako kuma an liƙa shi bayan ƙidaya
cert.q1-b.ig: Mgbe a kwupụtara nsonaazụ ma gosi ya ọha mgbe ọgụgụ gachara
cert.q1-b.yo: Nígbà tí wọ́n bá kéde àbájáde tí wọ́n sì lẹ̀ ẹ́ lẹ́yìn ìkà

cert.q1-c.en: Later, from a picture someone sends you
cert.q1-c.ha: Daga baya, daga hoton da wani ya aiko maka
cert.q1-c.ig: Emesịa, site na foto mmadụ zitere gị
cert.q1-c.yo: Lẹ́yìn náà, láti inú fọ́tò tí ẹnìkan fi ránṣẹ́ sí ọ

cert.q1-why.en: Stay for the count. The presiding officer counts the ballots in public and fills in the EC8A; the announcement is the moment that matters. Photograph only what is posted or handed out.
cert.q1-why.ha: Ka tsaya domin ƙidaya. Jami’in zaɓe mai jagoranci yana ƙidaya ƙuri’u a gaban jama’a kuma ya cike EC8A; sanarwar ita ce lokacin da ya fi muhimmanci. Ka ɗauki hoton abin da aka liƙa ko aka ba ka kawai.
cert.q1-why.ig: Nọrọ maka ọgụgụ. Onye isi ọrụ ntuli aka na-agụ akwụkwọ ntuli aka n’ihu ọha ma dejupụta EC8A; mkpọsa ahụ bụ oge kachasị mkpa. See foto naanị ihe e gosiri ọha ma ọ bụ nke e nyere gị.
cert.q1-why.yo: Dúró fún ìkà. Olórí òṣìṣẹ́ ìdìbò ń ka ìwé ìdìbò ní gbangba, ó sì ń kọ EC8A; ìkéde náà ni àkókò tí ó ṣe pàtàkì. Ya fọ́tò ohun tí wọ́n lẹ̀ ní gbangba tàbí tí wọ́n fún ọ nìkan.

cert.q2.en: Can you report with a photo from your gallery, or a screenshot?
cert.q2.ha: Za ka iya kai rahoto da hoto daga gallery ɗinka, ko hoton allo?
cert.q2.ig: Ị nwere ike iji foto sitere na gallery gị, ma ọ bụ foto ihuenyo, kọọ akụkọ?
cert.q2.yo: Ṣé o lè fi fọ́tò láti gallery rẹ, tàbí fọ́tò ojú ìwé, jábọ̀?

cert.q2-a.en: No. Photos are taken live in the app, at the unit
cert.q2-a.ha: A’a. Ana ɗaukar hotuna kai tsaye a cikin manhajar, a rukunin
cert.q2-a.ig: Mba. A na-ese foto ozugbo n’ime ngwa ahụ, na ngalaba ahụ
cert.q2-a.yo: Rárá. A ń ya fọ́tò tààrà nínú áàpù, ní ẹ̀ka náà

cert.q2-b.en: Yes, if the photo is clear
cert.q2-b.ha: Eh, idan hoton ya fita sosai
cert.q2-b.ig: Ee, ọ bụrụ na foto ahụ doro anya
cert.q2-b.yo: Bẹ́ẹ̀ni, tí fọ́tò náà bá ṣe kedere

cert.q2-c.en: Yes, if a friend at the unit sent it
cert.q2-c.ha: Eh, idan wani abokinka a rukunin ya aiko shi
cert.q2-c.ig: Ee, ọ bụrụ na enyi nọ na ngalaba ahụ zitere ya
cert.q2-c.yo: Bẹ́ẹ̀ni, tí ọ̀rẹ́ kan ní ẹ̀ka náà bá fi ránṣẹ́

cert.q2-why.en: Live photos only: no gallery uploads, no screenshots. Each photo is GPS-stamped when it is taken, which makes a report hard to fake from somewhere else.
cert.q2-why.ha: Hotunan kai tsaye kaɗai: babu ɗorawa daga gallery, babu hoton allo. Ana sanya wa kowane hoto alamar GPS a lokacin da aka ɗauke shi, wanda ke sa rahoto ya yi wuyar ƙirƙira daga wani wuri.
cert.q2-why.ig: Naanị foto ozugbo: ọ dịghị mbulite gallery, ọ dịghị foto ihuenyo. A na-etinye akara GPS na foto ọ bụla mgbe e sere ya, nke na-eme ka ọ sie ike ịgha akụkọ ụgha site n’ebe ọzọ.
cert.q2-why.yo: Fọ́tò tààrà nìkan: kò sí ìgbésókè gallery, kò sí fọ́tò ojú ìwé. A ń fi àmì GPS sí fọ́tò kọ̀ọ̀kan nígbà tí a bá yà á, èyí sì ń jẹ́ kí ó ṣòro láti parọ́ ìròyìn láti ibòmíràn.

cert.q3.en: What do you type into your report?
cert.q3.ha: Me za ka rubuta a cikin rahotonka?
cert.q3.ig: Gịnị ka ị na-ede n’akụkọ gị?
cert.q3.yo: Kí ni o máa tẹ̀ sínú ìròyìn rẹ?

cert.q3-a.en: Your own estimate of the votes

cert.q3-b.en: The figures someone at the unit tells you
cert.q3-b.ha: Alkaluman da wani a rukunin ya faɗa maka
cert.q3-b.ig: Ọnụọgụ mmadụ nọ na ngalaba ahụ gwara gị
cert.q3-b.yo: Àwọn nọ́mbà tí ẹnìkan ní ẹ̀ka náà sọ fún ọ

cert.q3-c.en: Each party’s figure exactly as announced
cert.q3-c.ha: Adadin kowace jam’iyya daidai yadda aka sanar
cert.q3-c.ig: Ọnụọgụ pati ọ bụla kpọmkwem dị ka a kwupụtara ya
cert.q3-c.yo: Nọ́mbà ẹgbẹ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan gẹ́lẹ́ bí wọ́n ṣe kéde rẹ̀

cert.q3-why.en: Type each party’s announced figure exactly, then sign and submit while you are still at the unit. Reports are permanent: nothing can be edited or deleted after signing.
cert.q3-why.ha: Ka rubuta adadin da aka sanar na kowace jam’iyya daidai, sannan ka sanya hannu ka aika yayin da kake a rukunin. Rahotanni na dindindin ne: ba za a iya gyara ko share komai ba bayan an sanya hannu.
cert.q3-why.ig: Pịnye ọnụọgụ a kwupụtara maka pati ọ bụla kpọmkwem, wee bịanye aka ma zipu ya mgbe ị ka nọ na ngalaba ahụ. Akụkọ bụ nke ebighị ebi: enweghị ike idezi ma ọ bụ hichapụ ihe ọ bụla mgbe e bịanyechara aka.
cert.q3-why.yo: Tẹ nọ́mbà tí wọ́n kéde fún ẹgbẹ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan gẹ́lẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà fọwọ́ sí i kí o sì fi ránṣẹ́ nígbà tí o ṣì wà ní ẹ̀ka náà. Àwọn ìròyìn jẹ́ ayérayé: a kò lè ṣàtúnṣe tàbí pa ohunkóhun rẹ́ lẹ́yìn ìfọwọ́sí.

cert.q4.en: How should you treat election officials, voters and materials?
cert.q4.ha: Yaya ya kamata ka yi mu’amala da jami’an zaɓe, masu zaɓe da kayan zaɓe?
cert.q4.ig: Kedu ka i kwesịrị isi mesoo ndị ọrụ ntuli aka, ndị ntuli aka na ngwa ntuli aka?
cert.q4.yo: Báwo ló ṣe yẹ kí o bá àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìdìbò, àwọn olùdìbò àti àwọn ohun èlò ìdìbò lò?

cert.q4-a.en: Never interfere, and follow officials’ instructions
cert.q4-a.ha: Kada ka taɓa tsoma baki, kuma ka bi umarnin jami’ai
cert.q4-a.ig: Etinyela aka n’ọrụ ha, ma soro ntụziaka ndị ọrụ
cert.q4-a.yo: Má ṣe dí wọn lọ́wọ́ láé, kí o sì tẹ̀lé ìtọ́ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́

cert.q4-b.en: Step in if you think an official made a mistake
cert.q4-b.ha: Ka shiga tsakani idan kana ganin jami’i ya yi kuskure
cert.q4-b.ig: Tinye aka ma ọ bụrụ na i chere na onye ọrụ mehiere
cert.q4-b.yo: Dá sí i tí o bá rò pé òṣìṣẹ́ kan ṣe àṣìṣe

cert.q4-c.ha: Ka duba takardun ƙuri’a da kanka
cert.q4-c.ig: Lelee akwụkwọ ntuli aka n’onwe gị
cert.q4-c.yo: Yẹ ìwé ìdìbò wò fúnra rẹ

cert.q4-why.en: Never interfere with election officials, voters or materials. Follow officials’ instructions, and follow the Electoral Act and INEC’s rules.
cert.q4-why.ha: Kada ka taɓa tsoma baki ga jami’an zaɓe, masu zaɓe ko kayan zaɓe. Ka bi umarnin jami’ai, kuma ka bi Dokar Zaɓe da ƙa’idojin INEC.
cert.q4-why.ig: Etinyela aka n’ọrụ ndị ọrụ ntuli aka, ndị ntuli aka ma ọ bụ ngwa ntuli aka. Soro ntụziaka ndị ọrụ, ma soro Iwu Ntuli Aka na iwu INEC.
cert.q4-why.yo: Má ṣe dí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìdìbò, àwọn olùdìbò tàbí àwọn ohun èlò ìdìbò lọ́wọ́. Tẹ̀lé ìtọ́ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́, kí o sì tẹ̀lé Òfin Ìdìbò àti àwọn òfin INEC.

cert.q5.en: Trouble breaks out at your polling unit. What do you do?
cert.q5.ha: Tashin hankali ya ɓarke a rukunin zaɓenka. Me za ka yi?
cert.q5.ig: Nsogbu dapụtara na ngalaba ntuli aka gị. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
cert.q5.yo: Wàhálà bẹ́ sílẹ̀ ní ẹ̀ka ìdìbò rẹ. Kí ni o máa ṣe?

cert.q5-a.en: Stay and keep photographing, whatever happens
cert.q5-a.ha: Ka tsaya ka ci gaba da ɗaukar hotuna, komai ya faru
cert.q5-a.ig: Nọrọ ma na-ese foto, ihe ọ bụla mee
cert.q5-a.yo: Dúró kí o máa ya fọ́tò lọ, ohun yòówù kí ó ṣẹlẹ̀

cert.q5-b.en: Leave, and report it later from somewhere safe
cert.q5-b.ha: Ka bar wurin, ka kai rahoto daga baya daga wuri mai aminci
cert.q5-b.ig: Pụọ, ma kọọ ya emesịa site n’ebe nchekwa
cert.q5-b.yo: Kúrò níbẹ̀, kí o sì fi ìròyìn ránṣẹ́ lẹ́yìn náà láti ibi tí ó ní àbò

cert.q5-c.ha: Ka yi ƙoƙarin dakatar da shi da kanka
cert.q5-c.yo: Gbìyànjú láti dá a dúró fúnra rẹ

cert.q5-why.en: No result is worth your life. If there is trouble, leave, and report it later from somewhere safe.
cert.q5-why.ha: Babu sakamakon da ya fi ranka daraja. Idan an sami tashin hankali, ka bar wurin, ka kai rahoto daga baya daga wuri mai aminci.
cert.q5-why.ig: Ọ dịghị nsonaazụ ọ bụla dị mkpa karịa ndụ gị. Ọ bụrụ na nsogbu dapụtara, pụọ, ma kọọ ya emesịa site n’ebe nchekwa.
cert.q5-why.yo: Kò sí àbájáde kankan tí ó ṣe pàtàkì ju ẹ̀mí rẹ lọ. Tí wàhálà bá wà, kúrò níbẹ̀, kí o sì fi ìròyìn ránṣẹ́ lẹ́yìn náà láti ibi tí ó ní àbò.

cert.q6.ha: Yaushe ake yi wa ƙidaya alamar “an tabbatar”?
cert.q6.ig: Kedu mgbe a na-akara ọnụọgụgụ “e nyochara”?
cert.q6.yo: Nígbà wo ni a ń fi àmì “a fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀” sí ìkà kan?

cert.q6-a.en: As soon as one observer reports it
cert.q6-a.ha: Da zarar mai lura ɗaya ya kai rahotonta
cert.q6-a.ig: Ozugbo otu onye na-ekiri ihe kọrọ ya
cert.q6-a.yo: Ní kété tí olùwòran kan bá jábọ̀ rẹ̀

cert.q6-b.en: When it is shared widely online
cert.q6-b.ha: Idan an yaɗa ta sosai a intanet
cert.q6-b.ig: Mgbe e kesara ya nke ukwuu n’ịntanetị
cert.q6-b.yo: Nígbà tí wọ́n bá pín in káàkiri lórí ayélujára

cert.q6-c.en: When independent observers at the same unit report matching numbers
cert.q6-c.ha: Idan masu lura masu zaman kansu a rukuni ɗaya suka kai rahoton alkaluma iri ɗaya
cert.q6-c.ig: Mgbe ndị na-ekiri ihe nweere onwe ha nọ n’otu ngalaba kọrọ ọnụọgụ dakọrọ
cert.q6-c.yo: Nígbà tí àwọn olùwòran olómìnira ní ẹ̀ka kan náà bá jábọ̀ nọ́mbà tí ó bá ara wọn mu

cert.q6-why.en: No single report is trusted on its own. A count is verified when independent observers at the same unit report matching numbers, backed by GPS, matching venue photos and the digits read from the sheet. Hawkeye does not declare results: official results are INEC’s.
cert.q6-why.ha: Ba a amince da rahoto ɗaya shi kaɗai ba. Ana tabbatar da ƙidaya idan masu lura masu zaman kansu a rukuni ɗaya suka kai rahoton alkaluma iri ɗaya, tare da GPS, hotunan wuri masu kama da juna da lambobin da aka karanta daga takardar. Hawkeye ba ta sanar da sakamako: sakamako na hukuma na INEC ne.
cert.q6-why.ig: A naghị atụkwasị obi n’otu akụkọ naanị ya. A na-enyocha ọnụọgụgụ mgbe ndị na-ekiri ihe nweere onwe ha nọ n’otu ngalaba kọrọ ọnụọgụ dakọrọ, nke GPS, foto ebe ahụ dakọrọ na ọnụọgụ a gụrụ site na mpempe akwụkwọ ahụ kwadoro. Hawkeye anaghị ekwupụta nsonaazụ: nsonaazụ gọọmentị bụ nke INEC.
cert.q6-why.yo: A kì í gbẹ́kẹ̀lé ìròyìn kan ṣoṣo fúnra rẹ̀. A ń fìdí ìkà múlẹ̀ nígbà tí àwọn olùwòran olómìnira ní ẹ̀ka kan náà bá jábọ̀ nọ́mbà tí ó bá ara wọn mu, pẹ̀lú GPS, fọ́tò ibi ìdìbò tí ó jọra àti àwọn nọ́mbà tí a kà láti inú ìwé náà. Hawkeye kì í kéde àbájáde: àbájáde ìjọba jẹ́ ti INEC.

cert.q7.ha: Me Hawkeye ba ta taɓa bayyanawa ba?
cert.q7.ig: Gịnị ka Hawkeye na-adịghị ekpughe mgbe ọ bụla?
cert.q7.yo: Kí ni Hawkeye kì í pín rárá?

cert.q7-a.en: The count reported at a polling unit
cert.q7-a.ha: Ƙidayar da aka kai rahotonta a rukunin zaɓe
cert.q7-a.ig: Ọnụọgụgụ a kọrọ na ngalaba ntuli aka
cert.q7-a.yo: Ìkà tí a jábọ̀ ní ẹ̀ka ìdìbò kan

cert.q7-b.en: Your phone number, or who watches which polling unit
cert.q7-b.ha: Lambar wayarka, ko wanda ke lura da wane rukunin zaɓe
cert.q7-b.ig: Nọmba ekwentị gị, ma ọ bụ onye na-ekiri ngalaba ntuli aka ọ bụla
cert.q7-b.yo: Nọ́mbà fóònù rẹ, tàbí ẹni tí ń wo ẹ̀ka ìdìbò wo

cert.q7-why.en: Your phone number is hashed and never published or shared. Hawkeye never shares who watches which polling unit: not with a captain, not with a party, not with anyone.
cert.q7-why.ha: Ana yi wa lambar wayarka hash kuma ba a taɓa wallafa ta ko raba ta ba. Hawkeye ba ta taɓa bayyana wanda ke lura da wane rukunin zaɓe ba: ba ga kyaftin ba, ba ga jam’iyya ba, ba ga kowa ba.
cert.q7-why.ig: A na-eme nọmba ekwentị gị hash, a naghịkwa ebipụta ya ma ọ bụ kesaa ya. Hawkeye anaghị ekpughe onye na-ekiri ngalaba ntuli aka ọ bụla: ọ bụghị onye ndú, ọ bụghị otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị, ọ bụghị onye ọ bụla.
cert.q7-why.yo: A ń ṣe nọ́mbà fóònù rẹ ní hash, a kì í sì í tẹ̀ ẹ́ jáde tàbí pín in. Hawkeye kì í sọ ẹni tí ń wo ẹ̀ka ìdìbò wo: kì í ṣe fún olùdarí, kì í ṣe fún ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú, kì í ṣe fún ẹnikẹ́ni.

cert.share-text.en: I completed a Hawkeye practice run and the observer quiz. Check my certificate: {url}
cert.share-text.ha: Na kammala gwajin atisaye na Hawkeye da tambayoyin mai lura. Duba takardar shaidata: {url}
cert.share-text.ig: Emechala m ọsọ omume Hawkeye na ajụjụ onye na-ekiri ihe. Lelee asambodo m: {url}
cert.share-text.yo: Mo ti parí eré àdánwò Hawkeye àti ìdánwò olùwòran. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìwé-ẹ̀rí mi: {url}

n.app.certificate.print.ha: Buga ko ajiye a matsayin PDF
n.app.certificate.print.ig: Bipụta ma ọ bụ chekwaa dị ka PDF
n.app.certificate.print.yo: Tẹ̀ jáde tàbí fi pamọ́ bí PDF

n.app.certificate.save-failed.en: Could not save the image. Take a screenshot instead, or print it.
n.app.certificate.save-failed.ha: Ba a iya ajiye hoton ba. Ka ɗauki hoton allo a maimakon haka, ko ka buga shi.
n.app.certificate.save-failed.ig: Enweghị ike ichekwa foto ahụ. Were foto ihuenyo kama, ma ọ bụ bipụta ya.
n.app.certificate.save-failed.yo: A kò lè fi àwòrán náà pamọ́. Ya fọ́tò ojú ìwé dípò rẹ̀, tàbí tẹ̀ ẹ́ jáde.

n.app.certificate.saved.yo: A ti fi pamọ́ sí àwọn fọ́tò rẹ.
